description: This file contains unit tests for the 'credits' utility functions and related data normalization checks in a JavaScript backend. It tests functions like 'usdToCredits' and 'getCreditsPerUsd', and verifies the presence of certain fields in project/user objects relevant to credits calculations.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Retrieves the exchange rate of credits per USD, defaulting to 20000 if environment variable is unset.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount into credits based on the current exchange rate, handling string and numeric inputs and invalid values.
